rana (eng-runtime): FYI rolled CANARY: slot-prewarm + kernel-select-hint. Short note on why + early numbers.

otto (perf): curious — top-level results?

rana (eng-runtime): 2.5h snapshot:
- token cost: -12.4% on short/interactive flows
- throughput: +7% net
- p50: -9ms, p95: -18ms, p99: -70ms
- fewer cold-scheduling stalls (host warm hit +30%)

hua (bench): raw: host=c-omega-7 window=150m requests=41k kernel_hint_hits=42%

leo (sre): deploy-bot status? any infra surprises?

deploy-bot: rollout/2191001111 -> SUCCESS (03:12 UTC). warnings=6 (prefetch timeouts), errors=0.

rana (eng-runtime): quick explainer: slot-prewarm proactively allocates a transient slot when a model session shows high short-turn probability; kernel-select-hint nudges the runtime to prefer faster fusion kernels for small sequence lengths. Together reduces per-request setup and better utilizes tiny microbatches.

otto (perf): interesting p99 drop. guess is fewer cold hosts + faster kernels = tail win. Any regressions to watch?

rana (eng-runtime): embeddings and large-batch jobs saw a slight cost uptick (+4%) due to prewarm allocations; we excluded known heavy-batch tenants from the next ramp.

hua (bench): gating metrics proposed (15m windows): error_rate<=0.12%, cross-region_egress_delta<=+2%, embeddings_cost_delta<=+6%

leo (sre): @oncall please watch slot churn and host memory pressure. If host mem increases >5% sustained, pause.

sam (product): could be a nice marketing story if numbers hold. Please add 1-slide for weekly sync.

rana (eng-runtime): will ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 24h if gates hold. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/slot-prewarm/2191001111

hua (bench): I'll post full query and 6h snapshot later.

rana (eng-runtime): thanks all. will update 6h and 24h here.
